name: HOAP
summary: Humanoid for Open Architecture Platform — a knee-high research humanoid Fujitsu sold from 2001 so labs could develop walking and human-robot interaction algorithms on a common, openly documented body. HOAP-2 (2003) and HOAP-3 (2005) added joints, cameras and onboard processing.
notable: One of the first commercially sold research humanoids
Open control architecture for algorithm development
